ns2:section.sectionText: Lecture will begin on Monday, August 22, 2022 and discussions will begin on Thursday, August 25, 2022. Examinations will be held on Wednesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 14, October 12, and November 9, 2022. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. This course-based tuition is assessed on and non-refundable after the 10th day of class.
